{"id":1935063589,"question_id":42,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772393761,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1935063589/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trapping Rain Water","memory":"27.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int trap(vector<int>& height) {\n        int n = height.size();\n        stack<int>st;\n        int water = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) \n        {\n            while(!st.empty() && height[i] > height[st.top()]) \n            {\n                int mid = st.top();\n                st.pop();\n\n                if(st.empty()) break;\n\n                int left = st.top();\n\n                int width = i - left - 1;\n                int boundedHeight = min(height[left], height[i]) - height[mid];\n\n                water += (width * boundedHeight);\n            }\n            st.push(i);\n        }\n        return water;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trapping-rain-water","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1763}
